title: G0W0 Si k444, SG15 3s3p2d, full five-stage pipeline (fast loop demo)
note: SUPERSEDED by si-k888-sg15-g0w0 - do not reuse. The 4x4x4 SCF grid below is not the database screening grid: the Si record (si-paper-all_kpath) uses KPT_scf 8 8 8, and LibRPA builds chi0 on the SCF grid, so this case never reproduced the screening. It also left pyatb_librpa_df/ in input_dir, which makes LibRPA replace its own head term (21.24 instead of 14.66). Its GW table came out non-physical (Re(Sigc) ~ -1e4 eV) while KS and EXX looked fine. Kept only as the record of that failure; see known issues pyatb-headwing-dir-overrides-internal-head and pd-cut-coulomb-does-not-vouch-for-epsilon. Original description: 2-atom Si, k444 SCF, SG15 PP + 3s3p2d NAO + pca1e-6 ABFS (hashes identical to the database Si-SG15 set), nbands 44, nfreq 16, symmetry -1 so the NSCF keeps the band path, truncated to Gamma -> 0.85(Gamma-X) where the Si CBM lies; database reference gap 1.0596 eV.
